listing.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE (FFResonanceRecomp)
listing.summary: An early FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE port for Apple silicon Macs on macOS 26 or later. Build locally with your own Switch game and 1.0.1 update. The project reports early town and battle play. Missing effects, dark night scenes and crashes remain.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Use your own base NSP 0100606026F12000 and 1.0.1 update NSP 0100606026F12800 v65536, plus prod.keys. The project has not confirmed firmware needs, region or file hashes.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s make build instructions on an M1 or later Mac. Install the Xcode Metal toolchain, Homebrew, .NET and Python and allow 60 GB of disk space. The first shader build is estimated at two hours. Keep the rewritten game code, shaders and icons on your own device.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The project reports early play at 60 FPS with eight shader failures out of 73,496. It offers no release package and excludes Intel Mac, Windows and Linux.
